`once(fn)` — a function that runs at most once and returns its first result thereafter
(design R5).

```ts
import { once } from 'closeout/once';
```

## Functions

### once

Wrap `fn` so it runs at most once.

```ts
function once<T extends AnyFunction>(fn: T): T;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `fn` | `T` |

**Returns** `T`
